objects.summary: Generated paper/shadow state view with two datasets, fail-closed SEC capture not yet run, one rejected relative-value strategy, empty authoritative capital book and three external data blockers. Supporting projection only; not routing authority.

Generated state variant records two rejected relative-value strategies, substantially more evaluation fills and worse evaluation NAV while authoritative paper capital remains untouched. Demonstrates that generated state can materially change between snapshots and must be freshness-bound.

Sept-21 generated projection extends ETF/calendar data through a newer snapshot and records a true-reject classification for the same relative-value family. Research remains blocked on missing PIT inputs; data refresh does not imply new edge.
Two-dataset projection adds explicit fail-closed SEC-capture liveness details while core research/capital state stays unchanged. Useful observability, not proof that capture was executed.

Seven-dataset projection adds direct Hyperliquid/dYdX funding data with detailed provenance/caveats, while the same research strategy remains rejected and major research lanes blocked. Strong example that broader data capability did not automatically produce economic validation.
Post-reboot-like generated state with boots=2/ticks=385 and execution-time revaluation changes, but no new edge or capital activity. Snapshot differences reinforce projection-vs-authority separation.
Three-dataset state adds futures data but preserves the same research blockers/rejection. Data-plane expansion is real capability growth but not research success.

Same generated brief bytes appear across thirteen owner-recovery snapshots spanning canonical_w2, edge_lab, giga, horizontal, intake and runtime rails. This is direct byte-level evidence that divergent branches shared substantial state semantics; branch divergence alone cannot imply capability loss.

Eight-dataset projection includes Hyperliquid listing and funding datasets with explicit survivorship/PIT caveats. Despite much richer data, the primary research frontier remains blocked and the existing relative-value result remains negative, supporting the distinction capability/data growth != edge discovery.

Compact September operating context routes through North Star, live governance and exact branch handoffs; explicitly says STATE/CHIEF_BRIEF/default branch are not routing authority, discourages duplicate agents/full rereads, and requires durable GitHub checkpoints. Strong anti-restart precursor but still depends on a multi-file Blue routing stack.

October cleanup-era router centers CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE + CP12, distinguishes concurrent Oracle V1/V2/audit rails, disables mass cleanup and lists material unabsorbed historical sources. It formalizes capability/scientific-memory disposition before deletion and four closed authority flags.

Oracle V1 operating context claims V1 operational qualification only for exact runtime properties and explicitly denies extrapolation to economic expectancy/scientific completeness/live readiness. It adds GitHub-vs-host evidence separation, one-package work discipline, concurrency-safe reacquisition and V1-closed/V2-new-property boundary.

V2 Core context reused byte-identically across ten recovery snapshots. It defines pre-outcome V2 architecture laws: outcome sealing, Research Epochs, feedback lineage, model-PIT limits, ideation-level trial accounting, validator independence, multidimensional maturity, negative-memory scope and unchanged economic/prospective/live authority. Strong evidence of semantic convergence across branch rails.

Earlier compact Blue router emphasizes startup-token efficiency, current governance/handoff authority, targeted reads, adversarial review and durable GitHub state. It is simpler than later V1/V2 contexts but still carries multiple live routing files.

Very compact corrective-pass context explicitly says read economically, not ceremonially, avoid loading AGENTS by default and update existing draft PR #12 rather than create another. Valuable anti-overhead pattern, but branch/task-specific Git instructions make historical versions unsafe as current authority.

Edge-Lab/Blue-era operating context shares the same North Star, exact governance routing, integrity invariants and anti-duplication rules as neighboring versions. Another example of semantic continuity under branch-specific routing changes.

Provider-independent Builder transition: routes through BUILDER_ROLE/current released mission, keeps provider file compact, states old branch/PR names cannot establish authority and reinforces exact BASE_SHA plus proof-gate discipline. Simplifies earlier Blue-specific routing.

Very early July project context freezes specific NASDAQ datasets and presents Phase A/B/C results as already established and not to redo, with Phase-D target and a fixed working branch. It usefully preserves protocol intent but also demonstrates the exact stale-memory hazard later forensics corrected: narrative results/branch instructions were loaded automatically as if durable current truth.

October forensic/cleanup router makes CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE + exact live HEAD authoritative, marks September handoffs/default branch stale, preserves four authority fences, forbids competing V2 architecture and records repository-hygiene rules. It is a direct correction to the early frozen-mission CLAUDE pattern.

Current-mission file is explicitly converted from frozen task into a branch-aware router. It requires fresh HEAD and branch-specific V2/V1 surfaces, says old chat/STATE/brief/default branch cannot define the mission, and preserves authority/evidence separation. Same bytes across ten snapshots show this routing correction propagated broadly.

cross_object_findings.finding: CHIEF_BRIEF variants expand from two to as many as eight datasets and richer capture/provenance capability, while the core relative-value evidence remains negative and research lanes remain blocked. Data/engineering accumulation must not be used as a proxy for economic progress.

One CHIEF_BRIEF blob is byte-identical across thirteen snapshot paths spanning multiple major rails. This is direct evidence that much apparent branch divergence coexisted with shared capability/state semantics.

The early CLAUDE.md embeds results and branch instructions as already-established facts. Later versions explicitly demote provider files to compact routers, require fresh HEAD/current governance, distinguish GitHub from runtime evidence and forbid old chats/default branches from defining authority. This evolution directly addresses restart/stale-memory failures.

September contexts accumulated several Blue handoffs/governance files to establish authority. Later BUILDER_ROLE/V1/V2 contexts reduce that ceremony by using provider-independent roles and branch-specific canonical roadmaps while retaining exact proof boundaries.

Oracle V1 CLAUDE context carefully limits operational qualification to exact runtime properties and refuses to infer economic expectancy, scientific completeness or live authority. This is a positive example of a later document avoiding the over-promotion seen in July audit documents.
Bundle 0003 adds strong evidence about state projection, branch-semantic overlap and memory/router evolution but reveals no new current canonical product/runtime repair requirement.
